title: TradingView Replay

launchpad.outcome: Learn TradingView’s Replay for outside practice, then run the same workflow in AGHF Replay with the future locked.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Can I decide without the next candle?

slides.title: LEARN IT · TradingView Replay
steps: Open your chart and click Replay in the top toolbar.
Pick a historical date and start before the session.
The future is hidden from the cut point on.
Read the 4H. Build the 1H map. Observe the 15M.
Drop to the 1M when it’s time to execute.
Advance with Forward one candle at a time, or play at a slow speed.
If you take it, set the stop and target before you advance.
Record the result in your AGHF journal.
Never jump ahead to “see what happens”.

slides.title: PRACTICE IT · AGHF Replay
lines: Same workflow, inside the Academy. Try dragging the time slider forward: you’ll see what a backtest does with the future.
slides.principle: REPLAY SHOULD FEEL A LITTLE UNCOMFORTABLE. UNCERTAINTY IS WHAT YOU’RE PRACTICING.

takeaways: Start before the session; hide the future.
TAKE · WAIT · PASS at each candle.
remember: Replay should feel a little uncomfortable.
